subject: Using bsCollapse in an interactive RMarkdown

messages.author: 8a98edc55c6202fc
messages.subject: Using bsCollapse in an interactive RMarkdown
parts:
Would it be possible to use bsCollapse to hide codeboxes?
I an trying to use it to hide the answer to questions until the user is ready to check the answer.


Something like this just outputs the text in the document:

```{r,echo=F}
library(shinyBS)
library(knitr)
  bsCollapse(multiple = FALSE, id = "EX_collapse_01",
            
             bsCollapsePanel("#1 Show answer", knit(text = "seq(from=4,to=20,by=2)",quiet=T), 
                            id="col1", value="test1")

            ) 
```


Is there some trick to get the code to evaluate normally and show the normal boxes with the code and output?

Or is there other ways to get such a functionality?
